description: This file defines the data structures, enums, and function prototypes for JSON encoding, decoding, validation, and manipulation within a C project. It includes definitions for JsonNode, JsonTag, and functions for handling JSON data structures.

methods.name: json_decode
methods.description: Decodes a JSON string into a JsonNode structure.

methods.name: json_encode
methods.description: Encodes a JsonNode structure into a JSON string.

methods.name: json_validate
methods.description: Validates a JSON string for correct syntax.

methods.name: json_find_element
methods.description: Finds an element in a JSON array by index.

methods.name: json_find_member
methods.description: Finds a member in a JSON object by key.

methods.name: json_first_child
methods.description: Returns the first child of a JSON node.

methods.name: json_mknull
methods.description: Creates a JSON null node.

methods.name: json_mkbool
methods.description: Creates a JSON boolean node.

methods.name: json_mkstring
methods.description: Creates a JSON string node.

methods.name: json_mknumber
methods.description: Creates a JSON number node.

methods.name: json_mkarray
methods.description: Creates a JSON array node.

methods.name: json_mkobject
methods.description: Creates a JSON object node.

methods.name: json_mklonglong
methods.description: Creates a JSON long long number node.

methods.name: json_mkulonglong
methods.description: Creates a JSON unsigned long long number node.

methods.name: json_append_element
methods.description: Appends an element to a JSON array.

methods.name: json_prepend_element
methods.description: Prepends an element to a JSON array.

methods.name: json_append_member
methods.description: Adds a member to a JSON object.

methods.name: json_prepend_member
methods.description: Prepends a member to a JSON object.

methods.name: json_remove_from_parent
methods.description: Removes a node from its parent.

methods.name: json_check
methods.description: Checks for structure and encoding problems in a JsonNode.
